svg.title: Two singular endpoint integrals with different limits
svg.desc: The positive curves x to the negative one half and x to the negative three halves are integrated from a positive cutoff epsilon to one. The pictured cutoff is one quarter; the shaded areas are one and two respectively. Their exact truncated integrals are two times one minus square root epsilon, and two times the reciprocal square root epsilon minus one. As epsilon tends to zero from above, the first tends to two but the second grows without bound. Both integrands are unbounded at zero. The vertical scales differ, and the endpoint zero is handled by a limit rather than ordinary substitution.
